subsumed.unit: tests/actions-cache-proxy.test.mjs::restores: a service that keeps refusing the first read as busy ends as a failed restore, never a partial body
subsumed.evidence: The cache proxy test makes a busy blob service return 503 on every first read and checks the final restore response; the build tests exercise container start/readiness failures, not ranged cache restore or partial-body avoidance.

subsumed.unit: tests/anthropic-federation.test.mjs::a token Anthropic gives with less than two minutes left is used once and never cached
subsumed.evidence: A 90-second Anthropic access token must cause two exchanges on two immediate calls. The subsumer tests ordinary caching and a later clock advance across the two-minute window, not a token minted with an already short lifetime.

subsumed.unit: tests/api.test.mjs::development auth refuses production origin
subsumed.evidence: This uses a production APP_ORIGIN with development auth enabled and expects /health to refuse it. The console-host test makes APP_ORIGIN localhost but CONSOLE_ORIGIN production, a different half of the two-origin guard.

subsumed.unit: tests/api.test.mjs::every query parameter declares a type queryValues can produce from a string
subsumed.evidence: It scans every route query schema for types producible from strings. The other empty-array assertions concern generated console URLs and synchronous tenant commands; neither scans route query types.

subsumed.unit: tests/api.test.mjs::tenant scope is enforced independently of valid token authentication
subsumed.evidence: A valid agent token for one tenant is used to request another tenant's projects and must get 403. The installation test rejects a private GitHub installation bound to no tenant through an authenticated project-creation request.

subsumed.unit: tests/api.test.mjs::unbound private GitHub installation cannot be selected by a tenant
subsumed.evidence: The authenticated project creation tries to select installation 123 belonging to no tenant; the token-scope test only requests another tenant's projects with a valid token. Those are separate authorization boundaries.

subsumed.unit: tests/automerge.test.mjs::a request-changes from a review with incomplete coverage still blocks: withholding never needs full coverage
subsumed.evidence: It marks a request-changes agent review coverageIncomplete and still requires REVIEW_REJECTED. The other test uses an independent human request-changes verdict without incomplete review coverage.

subsumed.unit: tests/browser-switch.test.mjs::an ordinary build job is not affected by the browser switch
subsumed.evidence: It turns browserTesting off for an ordinary build and requires a build capacity claim. The multi-arch test turns armBuilds on and claims capacity; it does not test browser-switch isolation.

subsumed.unit: tests/capacity-reattempt.test.mjs::negative: the capacity bound does not lift the bound of other platform failures
subsumed.evidence: After capacity refusals use the shared platform retry budget, a CONTAINER_NOT_READY failure must exhaust it. The other tests exercise capacity's own bound or RUNNER_OUTDATED followed by LOG_GAP, not this code transition.

subsumed.unit: tests/check-packs.test.mjs::vendored and build directories never contribute a stack
subsumed.evidence: Valid manifests placed under node_modules, vendor and target/debug must be ignored as stack evidence. The unreadable-manifest test checks parse/read failures at ordinary manifest paths.

subsumed.unit: tests/configuration.test.mjs::every Worker variable, secret and binding read in src/ is registered
subsumed.evidence: It compares actual Worker env reads with CONFIGURATION_NAMES. The feature-gates test instead searches feature-switch call sites; the common empty-array assertion has unrelated inputs.

subsumed.unit: tests/credential-leak.test.mjs::recovery still accepts the target's configured secret
subsumed.evidence: The quality recovery test already succeeds with its target's configured deployment secret. This shorter positive case adds little behavior, but it sits beside the cross-target secret refusal and documents that the new scoping check still admits the configured secret.

subsumed.unit: tests/edge-auth.test.mjs::a real token is refused when replayed under another tenant or token identity
subsumed.evidence: It alters tenant, token ID and secret components of a real bearer token and verifies all are refused before tenant calls. The subsumer revokes an otherwise intact token and tests revocation.

subsumed.unit: tests/feature-gates.test.mjs::every non-placeholder switch in the registry has at least one gate call site
subsumed.evidence: It searches source for a gate call site for every non-placeholder feature switch. The configuration test scans Worker env reads against registered configuration names.

subsumed.unit: tests/migrate-azure-pipelines.test.mjs::@444
subsumed.evidence: The Azure negative table supplies Azure YAML shapes and expects Azure-specific diagnostic codes, lines and suggestions. CircleCI's negative table drives a different importer and syntax.

subsumed.unit: tests/migrate-drone.test.mjs::drone: narrower-behaviour cases report warnings with lines
subsumed.evidence: Drone and Woodpecker inputs here require warning-severity diagnostics with exact lines, then compilation. The Drone negative table and CircleCI table check error-severity diagnostics for other cases.

subsumed.unit: tests/migrate-drone.test.mjs::drone: negative cases report their code and line
subsumed.evidence: The Drone negative table covers Drone/Woodpecker parser and policy errors and requires codes, lines, suggestions and compilable partial output. CircleCI's table cannot exercise that importer.

subsumed.unit: tests/native-job-secrets.test.mjs::a same-repository pull request run receives the mapped secrets
subsumed.evidence: It starts a same-repository pull-request run and requires its mapped build secret in the manifest. The runner-capability success test uses an ordinary run and does not verify the pull-request trust boundary.

subsumed.unit: tests/native-job-secrets.test.mjs::negative: a secret whose project scope no longer includes the project fails the attempt
subsumed.evidence: It changes an existing secret's project scope away from the run's project after pipeline creation and requires SECRET_SCOPE refusal. The branch-scope test supplies a disallowed branch and also checks an allowed branch.

subsumed.unit: tests/native-job-secrets.test.mjs::negative: malformed capability entries count as absent
subsumed.evidence: It supplies malformed capability entries such as case changes, whitespace, arrays and objects and requires them to count as absent. The subsumers only supply missing or well-formed capability lists.

subsumed.unit: tests/prestage.test.mjs::a fork's pull request is never pre-staged
subsumed.evidence: With prestaging enabled and history seeded, a fork pull-request delivery must create no prestaged runner. The subsumer turns the prestaging switch off and sends a push, so it cannot cover fork isolation.

subsumed.unit: tests/pricing-single-source.test.mjs::no customer price is written by hand in the console or the guides (outside generated blocks)
subsumed.evidence: It scans console and guide content for handwritten customer prices outside generated blocks. The other scans search feature keys in copy and local declarations shadowing imports.

subsumed.unit: tests/quality.test.mjs::rollback failure holds target lock until reconciliation
subsumed.evidence: It checks the target lock immediately after a failed release is marked needsReconciliation. The active-release test covers an earlier state; the recovery test checks the lock after a human starts recovery.

subsumed.unit: tests/recovery.test.mjs::dangling references fail referential integrity verification
subsumed.evidence: Deleting a pipeline record makes a backed-up run reference dangle; restore must reject SNAPSHOT_INTEGRITY with a run.pipelineId violation. The evidence test removes or alters an R2 object and expects EVIDENCE_MISSING.

subsumed.unit: tests/target-connection.test.mjs::target connection test: an account-owned Cloudflare token is verified at the account endpoint
subsumed.evidence: It makes the user-token verify endpoint fail and the account-token endpoint succeed, then checks that the Cloudflare target passes. The healthy Workers test uses user-token verification; the AWS test uses STS.

subsumed.unit: tests/token-last-used.test.mjs::a refused command still counts as a use of a valid token; its rolled-back writes do not take the stamp along
subsumed.evidence: It requires a valid token's lastUsedAt stamp even when the authorized request ends in FORBIDDEN. The failed-stamp test injects a database write failure and checks the request result and log instead.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-billing.test.mjs::a developer never sees Settings, Billing even where billing is on
subsumed.evidence: It keeps billing enabled but changes the principal to developer and verifies no Billing navigation or billing.get call. The switch-off test uses an owner when billing is disabled.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-contrast.test.mjs::@63
subsumed.evidence: The dynamic test at line 63 checks text color pairs against 4.5:1 for both themes. The line-67 test checks control edges, focus ring, switch and chart marks against 3:1.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-contrast.test.mjs::@67
subsumed.evidence: The dynamic test at line 67 checks non-text contrast pairs against 3:1. The line-63 test checks text pairs against 4.5:1; each uses a different pair list and threshold.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-features.test.mjs::console copy never names a feature switch by its registry key
subsumed.evidence: It scans console module lines for registry feature keys appearing as customer copy. The price scan and import-shadowing scan look for different patterns and would not detect leaked feature keys.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-import-shadowing.test.mjs::console modules: no local declaration shadows an import of the same module
subsumed.evidence: It parses console modules to catch local const, let or var names that shadow named imports. Neither the handwritten-price scan nor feature-key copy scan checks identifier collisions.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-quality.test.mjs::web performance: the browser copy of the report model is the server module, byte for byte
subsumed.evidence: It compares the generated browser web-report module byte for byte with the server source and checks its generated header. The browser image test checks Docker package versions and integrity pins.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every context item and main menu item opens a routed page; markers left from the split are reported
subsumed.evidence: It walks every context item and main menu item, checks route resolution, active item and leftover TODO/old-link markers. Link crawl, accessibility, redirect and route-context audits do not substitute for that navigation inventory.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every in-app link on every page (owner, seeded data) opens a routed page
subsumed.evidence: It renders owner pages with seeded data and follows their actual in-app links, finding dead or stale links. The other route audits inspect declared context/menu routes, page accessibility, redirects or route metadata.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every page has one h1, labelled landmarks, one current context item, named controls and labelled fields
subsumed.evidence: It inspects rendered pages for one h1, labelled landmarks and fields, named controls and current context item. The other audits focus on routing and links, not rendered accessibility defects.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every redirect lands on a routed page, keeps the other query parameters and never loops; old links land on their new routes
subsumed.evidence: It exercises guarded redirects under several principal shapes and query values, checking destination, preserved parameters, loops and old-link mappings. The other audits do not cover those redirect semantics.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every route declares a valid context, or is a record, a global page, a redirect or an area without a context
subsumed.evidence: It validates route metadata: known context IDs, sections, record parameters and allowed context-free areas. The other audits follow links or inspect rendered pages and would miss a misdeclared route context.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-tabs.test.mjs::tabs: a hidden tab cannot be opened by value
subsumed.evidence: A hidden findings tab is assigned by value and must leave overview visible. The subsumers use visible tabs and normal or late initialization, so they do not exercise hidden-tab rejection.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-tabs.test.mjs::tabs: on arrival exactly one panel is open, the first tab
subsumed.evidence: It mounts tabs in the normal connected lifecycle and requires overview as the initial value and sole visible panel. The subsumer assigns tabs after connection, a separate lifecycle regression.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-volt-evals.test.mjs::Lists: an empty state never repeats the header primary as a second lime button
subsumed.evidence: Across five evaluation list empty states it requires exactly one primary button. The subsumers inspect unrelated not-found, pipeline-audit and get-started pages.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-workspace-dense.test.mjs::workspace pages have no context sidebar and no section picker (NAVIGATION.md)
subsumed.evidence: It opens six workspace-level routes and requires no context sidebar or section picker on each. The subsumer opens /settings/general and checks that a context rail works there.

subsumed.unit: tests/web-report-platform.test.mjs::revoking a link stops the public page immediately, and so does turning the switch off
subsumed.evidence: It tests a live share link through kill-switch off, back on, then explicit revocation, requiring immediate 404 after each denial. The views test checks the switch's count effect and never revokes.

subsumed.unit: tests/workflow-optimizer-api.test.mjs::daily limits: per project and per workspace
subsumed.evidence: It seeds five daily optimization records and requires a 429 OPTIMIZER_RATE_LIMITED refusal with no GitHub writes. The subsumer refuses fork and missing-workflow-permission cases, not rate limits.

pseudo.name: update
pseudo.evidence: update builds the code block, escapes/highlights content and wires Copy and Download. Component/page tests can mount the element without asserting its rendered content or those controls; an empty update survives.

pseudo.name: connectedCallback
pseudo.evidence: connectedCallback attaches the menu trigger's click and arrow-key handlers and ARIA state. Tests check menu presence or other menu methods, but an empty connection hook leaves its trigger interaction unverified.

pseudo.name: onClick
pseudo.evidence: onClick intercepts eligible same-origin app links, handles hashes and calls navigate. Route tests mainly open destinations directly; they do not verify delegated clicks, modifier keys or prevented-default behavior.

pseudo.name: <arrow@117>
pseudo.evidence: The plansSection onChange callback refreshes the quota table and audit after a plan change. Quota tests cover model/operations, not that both views refresh when this callback fires.

pseudo.name: draw
pseudo.evidence: draw filters configuration entries and renders count, table values, problems or empty state. The registry test exercises filterRegistry directly; opening the operator route does not assert draw's DOM output.

pseudo.name: renderEvidence
pseudo.evidence: renderEvidence reveals and fills the merge-evidence inspector with policy, reviews, digest and runs. Automerge tests check records or route structure without asserting this rendered evidence panel.

pseudo.name: setEmpty
pseudo.evidence: setEmpty chooses the candidates table's filtered, no-project or no-candidate action text. The page tests do not assert those table.empty states, so removing the body passes.

pseudo.name: stepBody
pseudo.evidence: stepBody builds the suite wizard's dataset, check, endpoint, gate and other step controls. Current suite tests validate model helpers and template selection, not the rendered step bodies.

pseudo.name: renderBanner
pseudo.evidence: renderBanner conveys plan status, approval and destroy requirements, drift and failures. The plan-page test checks actions and danger card but not the banner contents for these states.

pseudo.name: formTemplate
pseudo.evidence: formTemplate renders the structured pipeline editor's fields and job controls. Editor tests cover YAML and surrounding flows, but no assertion requires this form body.

pseudo.name: <arrow@892>
pseudo.evidence: The cleanup callback removes document and window handlers, clears validation timer and aborts an outstanding validation. Tests do not check listener/timer cleanup after leaving the editor.

pseudo.name: <arrow@173>
pseudo.evidence: The project picker handler updates projectId, URL query, footer and API request preview. The new-pipeline tests use a single project or inspect static review data without changing this picker.

pseudo.name: severityRow
pseudo.evidence: severityRow renders counts and an accessible severity summary. Quality tests check other summaries and pages without requiring this row's visible or accessible output.

pseudo.name: detectionNote
pseudo.evidence: detectionNote tells users when stack detection has not run and shows detected stack, commit and unreadable-manifest warnings. Quality-check tests do not assert these messages.

pseudo.name: opportunities
pseudo.evidence: opportunities renders Lighthouse advice, time and byte savings or an explicit empty state. Performance tests inspect report models/route text but not this table's output.

pseudo.name: <arrow@191>
pseudo.evidence: Changing the target should clear selected run, artifact, strategy and evaluation IDs before redrawing. Release wizard tests do not exercise this target-change handler or verify stale selections are discarded.

pseudo.name: badges
pseudo.evidence: badges marks feature recommendations, source-code custody, required binding and model calls. Feature-page tests inspect grouping and switches, not these informational badges.

pseudo.name: <arrow@185>
pseudo.evidence: The revoked-members group toggle changes showRevoked, query and drawing. The members test opens ?revoked=1 directly; it does not click the group button and verify the transition.

pseudo.name: reveal
pseudo.evidence: reveal displays the one-time token, Copy and a guarded Done action. Token creation tests assert request bodies and close dialogs manually, without checking the reveal dialog or its copy/close behavior.

pseudo.name: <arrow@82>
pseudo.evidence: The empty-token Show revoked and expired button sets the checkbox and reapplies the list. Tests do not click this action or verify inactive rows appear.

pseudo.name: load
pseudo.evidence: load fetches tokens, member directory and project map then applies them to the page. Existing tests provide API responders and inspect separate creation flows without asserting this refresh function's results.

pseudo.name: loadLog
pseudo.evidence: loadLog fetches and displays the selected sample job's log in the UI kit. Tests that render the kit do not select a node and assert the log label or lines.

pseudo.name: paxRecords
pseudo.evidence: paxRecords parses PAX path/linkpath metadata used by the JavaScript tar reader. Tar tests use ordinary tar/link cases; Python PAX tests exercise a different implementation, so JS PAX parsing remains unverified.

pseudo.name: oldestResultAt
pseudo.evidence: oldestResultAt computes the oldest packed or legacy result time for history/shard metadata. History tests cover rollups and migration data but do not assert this returned timestamp.

pseudo.name: scrub
pseudo.evidence: scrub removes a Dodo API key and limits provider error text. The billing test only checks the key is absent; if scrub returns undefined, a generic error message also passes, so the redacted provider message and length are unverified.

pseudo.name: Map
pseudo.evidence: The pointed-manifest branch reads verified evidence chunks into the previous inventory for backup reuse. Backup tests cover captures and restores but do not assert that a prior inventory is loaded or reused.

pseudo.name: forgetPlans
pseudo.evidence: forgetPlans invalidates cached plan assignments or catalog entries after mutations. Plan tests inspect persisted outcomes but do not prime a cache and require an immediate fresh read in the same isolate.

pseudo.name: runCost
pseudo.evidence: runCost totals metered usage_resources for a shadow run and supplies costUsd to system.shadow.record. Shadow tests use model costs or unmetered observations; they do not verify this service's metered total.

pseudo.name: nextOutbox
pseudo.evidence: nextOutbox finds the earliest future warm-runner outbox item so schedulers avoid duplicate or late wakes. Warm-runner tests inspect queued work, not the returned future deadline or enqueue suppression.
